notes.title: MAX'S BIRTHDAY DLC, An Update
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25939408/e93b477a4621b997bb25f0ca6a3bb6fc257831eb.png

We fought the clock and the clock won. The Max, Autistic Journey - Max's Birthday DLC was planned to be launched in time to celebrate Autism Awareness Day, April 2nd. However, the "publish" button litterally vanished before our eyes when we went to launch it on Friday.

You can get the stand-alone DLC on Itchio right now until the magical publish button reappears on Monday.

Since Max, an Autistic Journey came out the developer has donated a portion of proceeds from game sales to the Miriam Foundation, a charitable organization that helps people with autism spectrum disorders and intellectual disabilities lead fulfilling lives. For Autism Awareness Day, Professional Imagination will donate all sales from April 2nd of Max’s Birthday to the Miriam Foundation. To learn more about the amazing work they do please check out their website at: miriamfoundation.ca.

Now, since the Steam version won't be available til Monday, anyone who buys the DLC on Itch.io today will get a Steam key if they'd like. Also, Steam sales from Monday will be donated to the Miriam Foundation, since, obviously it is not available today.

“First off, a big thank you to everyone who has played Max, an Autistic Journey and sent through their thanks and personal stories. Since the game came out I have come up with a few ideas for DLC I wanted to make with my son. When I sat down with him to begin work I asked him what he would like to see and he just lit up and rambled off his ideas. It was so inspiring that all my original ideas were out the window and now we have the Max’s Birthday DLC!”

World Autism Awareness Day is an internationally recognised day on the 2nd of April every year, encouraging Member States of the United Nations to take measures to raise awareness about people with autism throughout the world. It was designated by the United Nations General Assembly resolution "62/139.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.3
notes.notes:
Greetings players new, old and soon to be. Just wanted to let everyone know that v1.3 has been uploaded. If you're not seeing the new version in your library please verify the integrity of your game cache. 

This update fixes some progression stopper issues a few players expereinced towards the second half of the game.

If anyone continues to expereince any issues please be sure to let us know! Happy gaming!

notes.title: UPDATE 1.2
notes.notes:
UPDATE 1.2
A major fix to the game engine's memory leak has been made so this new build should alleviate the remainder of lag issues. If you are still experiencing problems please let us know in the comments below.

    New memory leak fix that helps better manage memory usage
    Due to some confusion about the intent of the Mini-game Vaccination, new game dialog has been added so that it does not come off as an "anti-vaccer" statement.

notes.title: MAX UPDATE v1.1
notes.notes:
UPDATE 1.1 (9/1/16)
Thank you to everyone for your patience as we have been busy addressing a number of the issues you have been reporting; seeking out and squishing all the pesky bugs we could find. Below is a list detailing all that has been fixed/updated in this build. If you find that you are still experiencing issues with the game please let us know with detailed comments below.

   Optimized code to help prevent large memory spikes
   Balanced the HP of some of the lower/earlier enemies
   Optimized auto-heal after battle code
   Optimized top-left corner Picto picture management
   Changed Max and Adam dialog after Mathis battle
   Added new code to enable/disable jump ability on certain maps due to some issues it was causing (maps the require jumping, such as in the sewers, jumping is enabled)
   Updated graphics in a number of locations to help address memory issues reported
   Added an image preloader script with « Now  Loading... » screens to help with memory management

Please note that there is a known memory leakage issue in RPG Maker that is beyond the developer's control. However, the man behind Professional Imagination has reworked the game as much as he could to address this. A future update is planned as soon as it has been announced the issue if fixed on RPG Maker's end. 

   If your build is not auto-updating, please Verify the Integrity of your Game Cache: 
   Right Click on the game title in your Steam Library
   Left Click on Properties
   Left Click on Local Files
   Click on Verify Integrity of Game Cache
